children.name: Cystodictya formosa Moore, 1929
children.description: Bifoliate branches, 0.67 – 1.07 mm wide and 0.40 – 0.92 mm thick. Mesotheca 0.008 – 0.010 mm thick, granular. Autozooecia tubular, teardrop-shaped at their bases, trapezoidal to semicircular in transverse quadrate in cross-section, recumbent on the mesotheca for a relatively short distance, then bending upwards at low angles in exozone and intersecting the surface almost perpendicularly. Diaphragms lacking; long proximolateral hemisepta at zooecial bend present. Autozooecial apertures circular to oval, arranged in 4 – 6 alternating rows on the colony surface. Lunaria distinct, horseshoe-shaped. Vesicular skeleton well-developed, covered in exozone by thick stereom. Vesicles small, rectangular in tangential section, with rounded roofs, completely separating autozooecia in exozone in 1 – 2 rows. Autozooecial walls granular, 0.008 – 0.010 mm thick in endozone. Stereom well developed, 0.13 – 0.18 mm thick, consisting of laminated material, completely separating autozooecia in exozone.
